message: Assalamualaikum Everyone! I Hope You all are fine! Q1: Theorem from Module 65. Q2: How to construct a matrix from functions. Q3: How to write the basis. Q4: Find (F_1(x)), (F_2(x)), and (F_3(x)) at (x=(0,1,1)), where the values of (e_1), (e_2), and (e_3) are given. Q5: Define Apollonius' Identity. Q6: Show that (|ax| = |a|,|x|). Q7: A theorem statement was given. Show that (T) is self-adjoint. Q8: Show that the given matrix (A) is unitary. After solving, the result is the identity matrix. Q9: A very lengthy statement was given. Show that the given mapping is norm-preserving.
